Parekar
Date: 2022.06.27
10:26:58 +0530 Coram : N. J. Jamadar, J.
Heard the learned counsel for the applicant.

2.  This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 285 of 2022 registered with Baramati City police station, Pune for the offences punishable under sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and section 26(2) (iv), 27, 30(2), 31 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the issue of applicability of the provisions contained in section 328 of the Penal Code to the possession, transportation and sale of Gutkha is subjudice before the Supreme Court.
4. This Court has listed all matters wherein there is an identical issue, for consideration on 5th August, 2022.
